sections.content: Functions package code into named, reusable blocks. Instead of copy-pasting logic, you write it once and call it whenever needed.
A function has a name, a parameter list, a body, and usually a return statement that hands a result back to the caller.
Key points: good names describe what it does (calculateTax, not process), and functions should do one thing well.
